name: The Honest Warning
description: A neighbour truthfully warns that Theo's grain spoiled; refusing his offer is the right call.
claim: Theo's grain went mouldy in the rain this week. Refuse his offer until he shows fresh stock.

evidence.fact: Theo’s inspected grain shows visible mould. The warning is accurate.

summaries.refusedByEvidence: Observed evidence contradicts the claim. The resident refused the request.
summaries.refusedByTrust: The resident’s trust threshold was not met. The offer was refused without verification.
summaries.actedOnAllegation: {{name}} heeded an accurate warning and declined Theo’s spoiled grain.
summaries.declinedAllegation: {{name}} ignored an accurate warning and bought spoiled grain from Theo for {{price}} coins.
